claims: Continue CRRT with current prescription (blood flow 200 mL/min, replacement 2000 mL/hr, dialysate 600 mL/hr), monitoring filter pressures and fluid balance given severe metabolic acidosis and AKI.
Continue invasive mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings and titrate FiO2/PEEP to maintain oxygenation, reassessing ABG given persistent acidemia (pH 7.22, lactate 9).
Continue vasopressor support (norepinephrine, vasopressin, epinephrine) with titration to MAP goal, monitoring hemodynamics via arterial line.
Transfuse packed red blood cells for severe anemia (Hgb 6.3 g/dL) and monitor post-transfusion hemoglobin/hematocrit.
Recheck arterial blood gas and lactate to reassess severe metabolic acidosis and guide bicarbonate/ventilator adjustments.
Monitor coagulation panel (INR 2.7, PTT 46.9, platelets 50 K/uL, fibrinogen) and assess for bleeding given coagulopathy and thrombocytopenia.
Continue broad-spectrum antibiotics (cefepime, aztreonam, vancomycin) and follow up blood culture results.
Monitor liver enzymes and bilirubin (AST 1776, ALT 432, bilirubin 3.1) to track evolving hepatic injury.
Perform ongoing sedation/neurologic assessments (RASS, CAM-ICU, GCS) given deep sedation and encephalopathy.
Maintain temperature monitoring and active warming for hypothermia (35.7 °C).
